title: Article XI cooperating-path effect debt register
authority: Constitution Article XI temporary migration provision; HS-106-03
scope: Static effect-capable statements under holdspeak/ in the five ratified census families. Ignored source paths are included; bytecode, source maps, and vendored/generated static assets are excluded.
counting_rule: Count statements, not logical user actions. Every ambient boundary crossed by one action remains a separate site.
legal_effect: Bypass, mixed, and dormant entries are declared migration debt, not authority. Read and exempt_computation entries are explicitly triaged non-debt and grant no effect authority. No agent principal may reach a debt path named by this register. Covered entries record existing audited chokepoints and do not grant authority beyond those chokepoints.

status_definitions.covered: Every in-tree route reaches the statement through an audited chokepoint named by the census.
status_definitions.bypass: A reachable route avoids all named audited chokepoints.
status_definitions.mixed: Covered and bypass routes share this statement; treated as not covered.
status_definitions.dormant: No current production caller, but the ambient capability can execute without a named chokepoint; treated as not covered.
status_definitions.read: Effect-free information retrieval exempt from admission and receipts; authenticated principal and named read authority remain mandatory.
status_definitions.exempt_computation: Latency-sensitive model computation whose output returns to its caller; triaged explicitly, not migration debt.

The fixed gh view argv is read-only and explicit principals are checked, but run_github_cli_enrichment defaults principal to the ambient LOCAL_OWNER and the connector-pack caller omits it, so authenticated read authority is not mandatory on every route.
sites.closing_condition: Require a non-optional principal derived from an authenticated request or bounded delegation at every gh enrichment entry point; remove the LOCAL_OWNER default.
